question: Can the frozen causal topometric graph deterministically produce finite M-TARE-compatible global targets at every C08 frame without using future or GT routing information?
method: At each of 4773 sealed frames, update the frozen causal graph and select an observed exit stub by structural potential minus verified graph cost and retry penalty; use verified-edge Dijkstra for remote backtracking and package a map-frame M-TARE handoff without publishing it.
baseline: B0 current-scan semantics and GT oracle use the same graph builder and planner. M1D seeds 0/1/2 are the learned methods. Required fallback is a sealed FAIL; no planner parameter adaptation inside the run.

user_authorization.scope: Pending one immutable C08 Gate-5 shadow execution; no robot control, C09/C10, new inference, training or M-TARE benchmark.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User instructed: 现在继续推进,定好一个目标我要把整个流程跑出来; bound only to the already-presented next immutable C08 Gate-5 shadow run.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 C08 worlds, 4773 unique source frames, 5 methods and 23865 planner cycles are retained.
Every TARGET waypoint is finite and no farther than 4m from the current graph-axis pose.
Every remote route uses only trace-verified traversed edges; evaluator GT edge identities never affect selection.
A second full replay produces identical decision hashes for all 15 method/world streams.
Empty-frontier frames remain CANDIDATE_COMPLETE and never claim confirmed exploration completion.
New sensing/inference/training and C09/C10/M-TARE closed-loop reads remain zero; all evidence is sealed.
stop_conditions: Any source seal, graph tuple, tool or environment drift.
Any count, finite waypoint, radius, verified-edge, deterministic replay or forbidden-read failure.
Any attempt to publish /way_point, claim exploration benefit or tune the planner from this shadow run.
expected_evidence: Fifteen full JSONL shadow decision traces.
Per-method/world status, mode, target-churn and deterministic-hash metrics.
Raw log, environment identity, input/tool hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only; zero GPU, LiDAR, inference or training.
